name: mrl-deskbook
description: Knowledge base from the Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) Deskbook (Version 2025, 1 May 2025, OSD ManTech / Joint Service/Industry MRL Working Group). Use for manufacturing maturity and producibility risk in defense acquisition: ten-level MRL scale (target, not grade); demonstration environments; nine Section 2.4 threads; Adaptive Acquisition Framework pathway targets; assessment-to-MMP loop; contract language (Section L/M, SOW, AS6500A, DIDs); criteria adaptation for S and T, sustainment and depot, limited systems including ships, and industry gates; and OT cybersecurity screening inside an assessment. Manufacturing-readiness focused: it measures producibility risk and frames mitigation; it is not a technology-readiness (TRL) guide, not a full systems-engineering process model, not a cost-estimating or schedule guide, and not a deep cybersecurity audit method (see sibling packs for those).
